text: ANDREY (handoff): directed plan-aimed handoff > generic /compact. Attach as milestone kind=handoff, render on canvas (mandatory, expandable, timeline). Preferred continuation = /new same tab + self-sent first msg pointing at handoff, NOT compact. On-demand via CLI. Build now, NO real handoff this session.

HANDOFF synth (codex 63761d90, 1/2). PICK C: typed CanvasElement(kind=handoff) + linked Milestone(kind=handoff). Element=canvas render+deep body+stable id+history; milestone=task thread/timeline. Body externalized .codeterm/plans/<plan>/handoffs/<id>.md. Schema: handoff_id, schema_version, mode_intent(new_reseed|compact_seed|record_only), plan/project ids, goal bullets, plan_snapshot, current_state, in_flight(agents/panes/branches/sessions), next_actions(first 3 executable w/o context), foundational_rules, open_decisions, links, resume_prompt, integrity(git HEAD/dirty). Daemon composes deterministically; orchestrator supplies only operator-notes.

HANDOFF /new reseed (codex): daemon txn creates element+milestone → records handoff_reseed pending row keyed {pane,handoff,source_session} → sends provider fresh-context cmd (/new via CAPABILITY not hardcoded) → on SessionStart new session id → sends EXACTLY ONE resume message. Monotonic states created→new_sent→session_seen→resume_sent→done, idempotent, loop-guard via handoff_resume_of metadata + --force. Resume prompt = short imperative pointing at 'codeterm plan handoff show

--markdown' + agents.md + resume from Next Actions. --dry-run shows send sequence. compact-with-handoff = same artifact + provider compact cmd, weaker (spends tokens/stale focus); /new is default. Canvas: reset/branch glyph in step thread + orchestrator-group 'context reset' timeline spine, expand via worlds content-LOD, provenance chips old→new pane/session.
